Description:[/b][/size]
This is a map replacement that replaces the Riverland Farm map. It includes 3 waterfalls, animated water and the river sounds you hear around the towns rivers when you're closer to the water. It also has a picnic blanket to the south that changes with the seasons, and turns to snowmen in the winter and a flower bed to the right of your house. This map uses [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/891/?]Eemie's flowers[/url] and the willow trees from [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/rues-creepy-curios-and-spooky-aesthetics-updated-11-7.126419/]Rue's Creepy Curios and Spooky Aesthetics[/url]. You do not need to replace any of your trees or flowers. These are part of the map. All of the grass is tillable.

[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
Download either the version for Eemie's map recolor or for the vanilla grass color. Drop the corresponding xnbs into the folders I've put them in for you inside the rars and enjoy! (The optional files contain the full mod, both eemie and vanilla versions, but with the specified changes)

[b]If you are having trouble opening my or any other modders .rar files please update your WinRar, it should fix the problem.[/b]
